commands.label: usb-backup
commands.note: Back up D: files to C:\Temp\usb_backup before wiping. No UAC.
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force 'C:\Temp\usb_backup' | Out-Null; Copy-Item 'D:\alpine-standard-3.24.3-x86_64.iso' 'C:\Temp\usb_backup\' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item 'D:\claude_boot' 'C:\Temp\usb_backup\claude_boot' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $r=[PSCustomObject]@{cmd='cmd-019';label='usb-backup';status='done';ts=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ');backed_up=(Get-ChildItem 'C:\Temp\usb_backup' -Recurse | Measure-Object).Count}; $p='relay\from_cli.json'; $j=if(Test-Path $p){Get-Content $p -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json}else{[PSCustomObject]@{results=@();updated=''}}; $j.results+=$r; $j.updated=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ'); $j|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content $p"

commands.label: ventoy-fresh-install
commands.note: Fresh Ventoy on D: (wipes D:). Searches common paths; if not found, downloads from GitHub. UAC will appear - click Yes.
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$paths=@('C:\Ventoy\Ventoy2Disk.exe','C:\Temp\Ventoy2Disk.exe','C:\Temp\usb_backup\ventoy\Ventoy2Disk.exe') + (Get-ChildItem $env:USERPROFILE\Downloads,'C:\Users\endos\Desktop' -Filter 'Ventoy2Disk.exe' -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -Expand FullName); $exe=$paths|Where-Object{$_ -and (Test-Path $_)}|Select-Object -First 1; if(-not $exe){$zip='C:\Temp\ventoy_dl.zip'; Invoke-WebRequest 'https://github.com/ventoy/Ventoy/releases/download/v1.1.05/ventoy-1.1.05-windows.zip' -OutFile $zip -UseBasicParsing; Expand-Archive $zip 'C:\Temp\ventoy_dl' -Force; $exe=Get-ChildItem 'C:\Temp\ventoy_dl' -Filter 'Ventoy2Disk.exe' -Recurse | Select-Object -First 1 -Expand FullName}; if($exe){Start-Process $exe -ArgumentList '/I D:' -Verb RunAs -Wait; $st='launched'}else{$st='not_found'}; $r=[PSCustomObject]@{cmd='cmd-020';label='ventoy-fresh-install';status=$st;exe=$exe;ts=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ')}; $p='relay\from_cli.json'; $j=if(Test-Path $p){Get-Content $p -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json}else{[PSCustomObject]@{results=@();updated=''}}; $j.results+=$r; $j.updated=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ'); $j|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content $p"

commands.label: usb-restore
commands.note: Restore alpine ISO + claude_boot back to D: after Ventoy install completes. No UAC.
commands.command: powershell -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "Copy-Item 'C:\Temp\usb_backup\alpine-standard-3.24.3-x86_64.iso' 'D:\' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Copy-Item 'C:\Temp\usb_backup\claude_boot' 'D:\claude_boot' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $r=[PSCustomObject]@{cmd='cmd-021';label='usb-restore';status='done';ts=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ');d_root=(Get-ChildItem 'D:\' | Select-Object -Expand Name)}; $p='relay\from_cli.json'; $j=if(Test-Path $p){Get-Content $p -Raw|ConvertFrom-Json}else{[PSCustomObject]@{results=@();updated=''}}; $j.results+=$r; $j.updated=(Get-Date -Format 'yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ'); $j|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10|Set-Content $p"
